priority_of_identity_evidence: preserved activity.record_id joined to ChEMBL compound_record.record_id and molecule ID
explicit example/isomer aliases belonging to the current primary patent
literal chemical-name agreement with the current patent, after whitespace/case normalization
aliases for different patents: candidate links only, not automatic cross-patent renumbering
numeric_alignment: Preserve relation signs; use Decimal for exact uM-to-nM conversion. Agreement with values or row ordering is not independent structure identity evidence.
stereochemistry: Chromatographic isomer numbers cannot be assumed to be R/S assignments. Retain source isomer/sample identity; do not silently merge identities or invent configurations.
duplicates: Trace same molecule/structure, relation, value, endpoint and document. Repeated patent citations are not independent replication. Do not automatically restore excluded labels.
scientific_interpretation: Functional inhibition and biochemical enzyme inhibition are assay-defined outcomes, not direct binding constants.
disposition_rule: Unresolved compound/sample identity, endpoint or source correspondence blocks freezing or campaign export. Retain the source and explicit unresolved status.
not_preregistered_blind_analysis: These checks follow inspection of the prior saved run and labels. This review is exploratory, not an independent blind confirmation.
